title: Points workbench
summary: Convert a cylinder to a point cloud, export it and import it again, merge two clouds and make a structured cloud.

credit.changes: Words in Simplified Technical English, FreeCAD 1.1 names. The wiki has no step-by-step Points tutorial: the steps follow the pages Points_Convert, Points_Export, Points_Import, Points_Merge and Points_Structure, on a cylinder of radius 10 mm and height 40 mm. The pages have no pictures. The checks read the new clouds and the file.

hints: Find the workbench selector in the toolbar.

steps.why: Points of a known shape make a cloud that you can examine.
hints: Select the cylinder in the tree first.
Keep the default distance in the dialog.
Convert Shaft to points, default distance.

steps.say: Select the cloud. Push **{Points_Export|Export points}**. Save it as **shaft.ply**.
steps.why: PLY keeps each point; other programs read it.
hints: Find Export points in the Points menu.
Set the file type to PLY.

steps.why: The cloud you read back has the same points as the one you wrote.
hints: Find Import points in the Points menu.
Select the file that you exported.

steps.say: Select the two clouds. Push **{Points_Merge|Merge point clouds}**.
steps.why: Merge puts the points of two clouds into one cloud.
hints: Hold **Ctrl** to select both clouds in the tree.
Find Merge point clouds in the Points menu.

steps.say: Select the first cloud. Push **{Points_Structure|Structured point cloud}**.
steps.why: A structured cloud keeps its points in rows and columns.
hints: Select the cloud made from the cylinder.
Find Structured point cloud in the Points menu.
Structure the first cloud with a width of **100**.

steps.say: Done: a point cloud from a cylinder, written and read back, merged and structured.
